modal_quote: "I don't want to play CT. I prefer Boss Rush."
modal_desc: Banana Blitz is our dedicated Boss Rush team, built around fast island clears and getting everyone their rewards efficiently. You don't need to play actively — once the team has cleared all islands, you can collect rewards without having contributed a single attack. For players who do want to participate, Blitz runs in a coordinated and focused way. If you're already on a CT team, you can freely switch to Blitz for Boss Rush events and back again.
requirements: Present during Boss Rush events — be around when the event is running
No CT commitment required — this team is purely for Boss Rush
CT players are welcome — freely switch between teams per event
Inactive players can still collect rewards after the team completes all islands
